skills.name: Peek inbox inquiries
skills.description: Use when a new client inquiry arrives in Gmail and you must brief it without marking the message read.
skills.content:
---
name: Peek inbox inquiries
description: >-
  Use when a new client inquiry arrives in Gmail and you must brief it without
  marking the message read.
---
Brief new client inquiries from Gmail without changing the inbox.

## Do
1. Look up search_threads / get_thread on each connected Gmail account for this run. Do not reuse a stale schema.
2. Search is:unread in:inbox (narrow with CRM, Calendly, inquiry, or booking keywords only after a first unread pass).
3. Fetch a matching thread with get_thread and messageFormat: PLAIN_TEXT (or MINIMAL if that is enough).
4. Decide if it is a real inquiry (a person asking to book, hire, or buy). Skip newsletters, receipts, social, and noise.
5. Brief the user: which inbox, who, what they want, date/location if any, how hot. One short brief per new thread.
6. Remember thread ids you already briefed so you do not repeat.

## Never
- Do not mark read, archive, star, label, or modify the message.
- Do not call any Gmail modify/send/draft tool for this job.
- Do not send.
- Do not invent details that are not in the mail.

skills.name: Switch HoneyBook company
skills.description: Use when you need to open a different HoneyBook company on a shared login. The top-right company name is not a switcher.
skills.content:
---
name: Switch HoneyBook company
description: >-
  Use when you need to open a different HoneyBook company on a shared login. The
  top-right company name is not a switcher.
---
HoneyBook keeps multiple companies on one login. They do not share a pipeline or a ledger. The top-right company label is not a switcher. The top-left grid icon is not a switcher.

## Hard rules
- Read-only unless the user explicitly asks for a write.
- Never send messages, invoices, contracts, or reminders.
- Never delete, archive, refund, or change status.

## Inputs
- company: the brand company name the user wants open

## Steps
1. Be signed in at https://app.honeybook.com.
2. Click the circular profile / settings icon at the bottom of the left sidebar. A menu opens: My account, Company settings, Switch company, Log out.
3. Click Switch company. URL becomes https://app.honeybook.com/app/brands (Companies).
4. You will see company cards plus ADD NEW. Do not add a company.
5. On the target card, click Go to Brand.
6. Wait for "Switching to {company}…" then confirm the home header shows that company.
7. Do the work in that company only. Switch again before looking at another brand.

## Notes
- Direct URL https://app.honeybook.com/app/brands also works if already signed in.
- Different companies do not share numbers. Always switch before reporting money or pipeline.
